Alpha'' 1 |writer=[[Charles Soule]] |penciller=[[Steve McNiven]] |inker=Steve McNiven |letterer=[[Travis Lanham]] |colorist=[[Laura Martin]] |cover artist=*Steve McNiven *Laura Martin |editor=[[Mark Paniccia]] |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |release date=[[May 5]], [[2021]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/93642/star_wars_war_of_the_bounty_hunters_alpha_2021_1|text=Star Wars: War Of The Bounty Hunters Alpha (2021) #1}} |pages=25 |upc=759606201297 |timeline=[[3 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha'' 1 to [[3 ABY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]'' |issue=1 |next=*[[War of the Bounty Hunters 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 1]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 13|''Star Wars'' (2020) 13]] {{C|Crossover}} }} '''''War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha'' 1''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|one-shot]] and first issue of the crossover event ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]''. It was written by [[Charles Soule]], illustrated by [[Steve McNiven]] and [[Laura Martin]], and first published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[May 5]], [[2021]]. It features the prelude story "'''Precious Cargo'''," in which [[Boba Fett]] takes on a job while delivering [[Han Solo]] to [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]]. ==Publisher's summary== ''THE ''STAR WARS'' COMIC EVENT YOU'VE BEEN WAITING FOR! The notorious bounty hunter BOBA FETT has finally landed his greatest prize – HAN SOLO, frozen in carbonite for easy transport. Fett will bring the smuggler to TATOOINE to collect the massive bounty placed on Solo's head by the fearsome crime lord JABBA THE HUTT. Sounds easy. What could go wrong?'' ==Opening crawl== {{OpeningCrawl |name="PRECIOUS CARGO" |text=Boba Fett, the galaxy's most dangerous hunter, claims the bounty of notorious smuggler and rebel officer Han Solo. Jabba the Hutt eagerly awaits Fett's delivery of Solo's carbonite-frozen body to Tatooine, where the crime lord will exact his final revenge. Han Solo's debt is thus paid. But Boba is desperate for a payday himself….}} ==Plot summary== {{Plot|comic}} ==Continuity== The [[Garkata Fighting Arena]] is depicted as having [[Hologram|holographic displays]] surrounding its exterior, advertising the fighting matches. Many of these screens display characters and events taken from later in the issue, including Fett's fight with [[Wyrmen Lictor]], his conversation with the [[Yarkora]], and the [[death]] of [[Bigbot]]. Other holograms reuse art from [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sources, including images of a [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] from ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' and a [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] from the ''[[Balance of the Force]]'' expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Card Game]]''.{{FFGTCG|set=Balance of the Force|cardname=Shistavanen Wolfman}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha 1}} ===Editions=== *UPC 759606201297;
